Healthcare / Project breakdown

Dr. Kareem Shilwa

A medical specialist’s website needed to establish visibility in a landscape occupied by larger healthcare providers. The project organized content around patient questions and connected related topics through internal links.

dr-kareemshliwa.comGoogle Search Console3-month comparison
1.57KOrganic clicks
160KImpressions
Before / afterOriginal evidence below
In this case studyThe starting pointThe approachResults & evidenceWhat changedThe takeaway
01 / The challenge

The starting point.

The site started with 464 clicks and 30.8K impressions over three months. I focused on the symptoms and procedures prospective patients search for within the doctor’s specialty.

02 / The approach

What the work involved.

  1. Organize a specialty-focused topic map

    I grouped related topics around the doctor’s specialty to give the pages a clear structure.

  2. Connect related content internally

    I linked related pages so readers could move between relevant topics.

  3. Address more specific patient searches

    I targeted specific symptom and procedure queries in the content.

03 / The evidence

Before & after.

Google Search Console compares two consecutive three-month periods.

Dr. Kareem Shilwa performance comparison

Organic clicks4641.57K
Impressions30.8K160K
CTR1.5%1.0%
Average position12.712.1
04 / Reading the result

What the numbers tell us.

Clicks reached 1.57K and impressions reached 160K over the later three-month period. Impressions grew faster than clicks, and CTR moved from 1.5% to 1.0%.

05 / The takeaway

What this project shows.

The work gave patient questions a clear place in the site structure and connected them through internal links.
